hw_emulation.scope: Small three-die fixture, actual live routing calls through XRT with CPU kernel implementation absent; all deterministic output files equal C-model.

limitations: Full real graph uses C-model; XRT allocation limited to 16 slots/4 lanes/3 CUs
Search, subscription scan, net-set authority and atomic commit remain on CPU
Joined search phases with serialized CU calls; no autonomous asynchronous coherence
No physical implementation timing, board throughput/energy or new physical QoR
next_work: Batch scheduling and autonomous queues/publication; full-net hardware ownership/commit; mapping/migration ablations; representative physical QoR and board evaluation.
